563:t_000:20.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Fussing over someone day in and day out isn't the only kind of kindness. Especially where $$ニコラ$$ is concerned.」

563:t_000:23.en:
$$刹那$$
「Watching Captain $$アムロ$$, I feel how hard it is for people to understand each other.」

563:t_000:24.en:
$$シャア$$
「It's enough that you understand that.」

563:t_000:25.en:
$$シャア$$
「Understanding each other is necessary, but understanding alone won't get a human being anywhere.」

563:t_000:26.en:
$$刹那$$
「Maybe I still don't even properly understand what it means to understand each other...」

563:t_000:27.en:
$$グラハム$$
(Always reaching for what lies ahead, boy...)

563:t_000:28.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Let's take it easy, my friend.」

563:t_000:29.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Just as $$刹那$$ walks $$刹那$$'s path, you should walk yours.」

563:t_000:30.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Heh... Understanding each other is a wonderful thing.」

563:t_000:31.en:
$$チコ$$
「Those old guys are getting all buddy-buddy...」

563:t_000:32.en:
$$マリ$$
「It's so twisted that you can't just say they get along, nya. Besides, aren't people in their twenties too young to be called old men and old ladies?」

563:t_000:34.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Is this the time for stupid talk!? Here they come!」

563:t_001:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So that's the mysterious enemy that appeared at Jupiter.」

563:t_001:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「What the hell is that thing? Looks like a lump of metal...」

563:t_001:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Now that you mention it, this is your first time seeing them.」

563:t_001:4.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「For convenience, we're calling them the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

563:t_001:5.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「As you can see, they're best described as metallic life forms.」

563:t_001:6.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「And their most fearsome power is that they can assimilate a target into their own bodies, whether it's organic or inorganic.」

563:t_001:7.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Fusion through erosion... is that it?」

563:t_001:8.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「And I don't understand the mechanism, but their erosion attacks damage the pilot too.」

563:t_001:9.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If a pilot loses consciousness from their attacks, all that's left is to become their prey.」

563:t_001:10.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「So if a pilot's mind gets into a dangerous state during battle, I'll have you fall back.」

563:t_001:11.en:
$$ジン$$
「So even if the machine can still fight, the person riding it goes down first and is out of action, huh.」

563:t_001:12.en:
$$カグラ$$
「To think that kind of bunch would show up too.」

563:t_001:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「Communication is impossible with a metal opponent. In other words, they're $$バアル$$.」

563:t_001:16.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You heard it, everyone. Be extremely careful of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$'s erosion attacks.」

563:t_001:17.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Bouncing that back takes effort and guts! I'll show you!」

563:t_001:18.en:
$$赤木$$
「I'll follow $$ノリコ$$ with fighting spirit too!」

563:t_001:21.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Leave $$ニコラ$$ alone, $$タケル$$. Let's go.」

563:t_001:24.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Focus, $$ラルク$$. If you keep that up, you'll die.」

563:t_001:26.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Big Sis is going to... die...」

563:t_001:27.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Big Sis is going to... die...」

563:t_001:28.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Big Sis is going to... die...」

563:t_001:29.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...Someone I once knew suppressed their own feelings and fought for the Earth.」

563:t_001:30.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Even if it's a different world, if you pilot a $$バスターマシン$$ too, don't forget that feeling.」

563:t_001:34.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's go, $$ラルク$$. I'm asking you to back up $$ガンバスター$$.」

563:t_001:36.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin the attack! Don't let the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ through, no matter what!」

563:t_002:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Falling back because they judged they can't win... or does it mean their reconnaissance mission is over...?」

563:t_002:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Either way, we'll need to be careful.」

563:t_003:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Those $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are a pain to fight, unlike the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s or the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

563:t_003:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「You're right. If it were a clash of power against power, we'd just have to meet them head-on, but that erosion attack is just...」

563:t_003:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「About those $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$... it seems they detect $$脳量子波$$ and move accordingly.」

563:t_003:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So it's what we call psycho-waves in our world?」

563:t_003:7.en:
$$シン$$
「You mean those things are targeting $$イノベイター$$s like $$刹那$$ and $$ニュータイプ$$s like $$カミーユ$$?」

563:t_003:8.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It's not confirmed yet, but there are signs pointing that way.」

563:t_003:10.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「If we leave them alone, things will get troublesome.」

563:t_003:11.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Are you really that afraid of being targeted yourselves?」

563:t_003:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「Stop, $$ハマーン$$. Leave him be right now.」

563:t_003:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Neither psycho-waves nor $$脳量子波$$ are special powers of $$ニュータイプ$$s or $$イノベイター$$s. Faint as they are, everyone has them.」

563:t_003:15.en:
$$シャア$$
「And since the $$大時空震動$$, people's awakening to $$ニュータイプ$$ abilities has been progressing rapidly.」

563:t_003:17.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Director $$ナナイ$$ said so too. Apparently the tendency shows up regardless of whether they're Earthnoids or Spacenoids.」

563:t_003:18.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The same phenomenon applies to people becoming $$イノベイター$$s in the $$ＡＤＷ$$. There are already people other than $$刹那$$ whose awakening is advancing, and...」

563:t_003:19.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The number of latent awakened is growing to a level beyond our ability to grasp.」

563:t_003:20.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Is all of humanity trying to evolve...?」

563:t_003:23.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Talk later. Something else is coming...!」

kept_omissions: 563:t_000:28: Colasour's 'Let's take it easy, my friend' - addressee (Graham vs Setsuna) not settled by the scene; wording works for either
563:t_000:29: Zechs's あなた taken as one person (Graham, whose thought/laugh brackets it); 'you' kept singular
563:t_001:29: 'Someone I once knew' - Noriko withholds who (revealed as her Big Sis at t_001:32), gender-neutral on purpose
563:t_001:31: 'That person is...' - Lal'C's trailing question, verb kept but predicate left open as in the Japanese
uncertain: 563:t_000:28/29: who Colasour and Zechs are talking to (Graham most likely); Colasour's マイ・フレンド kept as 'my friend'
563:t_000:23: 大尉 = 'Captain' for Amuro (matches finished slices)
563:t_000:31/32: オジサン達 = 'old guys', オジサン、オバサン = 'old men and old ladies'; Mari's ニャ = 'nya' (settled ニャ～ = nya~)

563:t_001:26-28: Nono/Buster Machine No. 7/Diebuster echo the same line; お姉さま = 'Big Sis' (Nono's settled form) - refers to Lal'C, but Noriko's own お姉さま at t_001:29-32 (her senior, female by the word) also rendered 'Big Sis'
563:t_001:34: Noriko asks Lal'C (in Diebuster) to back up Gunbuster (Noriko's machine); rendered literally with the Gunbuster token
563:t_003:6/14: サイコ・ウェーブ is not in the glossary - plain 'psycho-waves'; アースノイド/スペースノイド = 'Earthnoids'/'Spacenoids' (Gundam official)
563:t_003:3: Mileina's アーデさん = $$アーデ$$ (no honorific), です tic not rendered
563:t_003:21: 'The same goes for $c' - what 'that' refers to (awakening) is inferred from Tieria/Zero's preceding lines
